name: Katrina L. Clauson
occupation: Teton County coroner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Katrina L. Clauson, also listed as Kat Clauson, is the Teton County coroner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Brent "Doc" Blue, who is serving through the current term. She won the November 2026 general election. No separate public-record account of her private occupation or education was confirmed in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
